title: Prefill and decode
summary: Which phase of generation is bound by what, and what that means for scheduling.

choices.text: Decode at batch size 1 is compute-bound, because attention over a long context does many FLOPs.
Prefill of a 2,000-token prompt is usually compute-bound: each weight read is used for 2,000 tokens.
Doubling the decode batch from 8 to 16 roughly doubles throughput while the step stays memory-bound.
Prefill and decode have the same arithmetic intensity, since they run the same layers.
A long prefill scheduled in the same step as decodes can stall them; chunked prefill splits it across steps.
